name: tiktok-vertical
description: Screen recording with the camera window on the right and the slide on the left -> 9:16 with the face on top, slide in the middle, captions at the bottom.

source._note: crop = width:height:x:y in the original recording; w/h = its resolution (render.py checks it). MEASURE AGAIN if the windows move.

subtitles._note: drawn with Pillow (src/vtk/captions.py): whole sentence, spoken word in 'highlight' (the orange of the slides' badge). Style A, chosen on 2026-11-05. font_file relative to the root.

audio._note: measured on the 1st video: voice ~-24 dB, background ~-61 dB, 37 dB of headroom. Noise reduction OFF: with the microphone used, afftdn made the voice robotic (2nd video). 2:1 compressor from the setting used in that video. Only turn denoise on if background noise shows up, comparing before/after. pre_limiter 'auto': postaudio computes the limit that keeps loudnorm linear (the old 1.0 did nothing and loudnorm fell back to dynamic mode). tp_margin_db: peak headroom for AAC; the final limiter sits at TP - tp_margin_db and the result is measured.

camera_filter._note: image treatment for the camera only. 'off' = none. Choose by looking at before/after.
